fib: ______ is the artificial application of water to crop for the purpose of supply moisture essential for growth, provide crop assurance against short drought and to facilitate continuous cropping among others.
Irrigation

Irrigation is the artificial application of water to crop for the purpose of supply moisture essential for growth, provide crop assurance against short drought and to facilitate continuous cropping among others.
______ is the least exploited basin in Nigeria extending from the Cameroon border to the Niger-Benue confluence.
Benue Basin Zone
The Benue Basin Zone is the least exploited basin in Nigeria extending from the Cameroon border to the Niger-Benue confluence.
______ is the wearing away of the top layer of the soil by erosion agents on land with little or no vegetation.
Sheet erosion
Sheet erosion is the wearing away of the top layer of the soil by erosion agents on land with little or no vegetation.
______ is the growing of two or more crops together in strips wide enough to permit separate crop production but close enough for the crops to interact.
Strip cropping
Strip Cropping Strip cropping is the growing of two or more crops together in strips wide enough to permit separate crop production but close enough for the crops to interact.
______ is the removal of excess water artificially from a farm land to prevent water-logging, promote good plant growth and promote farming activities.
Drainage
Drainage is the removal of excess water artificially from a farm land to prevent water-logging, promote good plant growth and promote farming activities.
______ is a land management practice which can significantly reduce rill erosion in hilly areas cultivated with annual crops.
Conservation tillage
Conservation tillage is a land management practice which can significantly reduce rill erosion in hilly areas cultivated with annual crops.
______ is a measure of the leaf moisture potential.
pressure required
The pressure required is a measure of the leaf moisture potential.
______ is the rate of everpotranspiration from a large area covered by green grass which grow actively, completely shades the ground and which is not short of water.
Reference crop everpotranspirantion
Reference crop everpotranspirantion is the rate of everpotranspiration from a large area covered by green grass which grow actively, completely shades the ground and which is not short of water.
______ is the ration of crop yield to the amount of water depleted through evapotranspiration (ET).
Water use efficiency (WUE)
Water use efficiency
WUE
Water use efficiency (WUE) is the ration of crop yield to the amount of water depleted through evapotranspiration (ET).
______ is an advance form of rill and sheet erosion that is unchecked.
Gully erosion
Gully erosion is an advance form of rill and sheet erosion that is unchecked.
______ is the sum total of irrigation water needed for a crop in a specified time plus the losses occurring in the field during distribution such as seepage percolation etc.
Irrigation requirement
Irrigation requirement is the sum total of irrigation water needed for a crop in a specified time plus the losses occurring in the field during distribution such as seepage percolation etc.
______ are used to determine when to irrigate.
Different methods
Different methods are used to determine when to irrigate.
______ is the most direct method of determining when to irrigate.
Monitoring crop or plants
Monitoring crop or plants is the most direct method of determining when to irrigate.
______ is an index to the need for water since it is related to the degree of stomatal opening and the rate of transpiration.
Stomata resistance
Stomata resistance is an index to the need for water since it is related to the degree of stomatal opening and the rate of transpiration.
______ is an important factor influencing fruit set.
Temperature
Temperature is an important factor influencing fruit set.
______ is the application of the irrigation water directly to the crop.
Application systems or irrigation system
Application systems or irrigation system is the application of the irrigation water directly to the crop.
______ is the frequent, slow application of water either directly onto land surface or into the root zone of crops.
Drip irrigating system
Drip irrigating system is the frequent, slow application of water either directly onto land surface or into the root zone of crops.
